description: This PHP file defines the ResetPasswordDao class within the OrangeHRM authentication plugin. It includes methods for saving password reset requests, retrieving logs by email and reset code, and updating the validity status of reset password requests.

classes.name: ResetPasswordDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for handling reset password requests, including saving and retrieving requests from the database.

methods.name: saveResetPasswordRequest
methods.description: Persists a ResetPasswordRequest object to the database and returns it.

methods.name: getResetPasswordLogByEmail
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent ResetPasswordRequest for a given email address.

methods.name: getResetPasswordLogByResetCode
methods.description: Retrieves a ResetPasswordRequest based on the provided reset code.

methods.name: updateResetPasswordValid
methods.description: Updates the 'expired' status of reset password requests for a specific email address.
